name: Photography
description: Photography word search puzzles gather camera-craft English for adults and seniors — lens, focus, frame, shutter, album and calm light words — without camera brands or software names. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays familiar and unhurried: aperture, darkroom, portrait, landscape, tripod and shadow vocabulary many lifelong photographers already know. This hub pairs well with Painting, Travel and Museums when you want a longer looking session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as quiet as a still frame.
